description: Defines the NuPlayer::Renderer class for media rendering, including buffer management, queue control, and event handling within Android's media framework.

classes.name: NuPlayer::Renderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering media buffers, managing queues, and handling media playback events.

methods.name: Renderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with audio sink and notification message.

methods.name: queueBuffer
methods.description: Queues a media buffer for playback, specifying if it's audio and a notification message.

methods.name: queueEOS
methods.description: Queues an end-of-stream marker for audio or video.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the specified media queue (audio or video).

methods.name: signalTimeDiscontinuity
methods.description: Signals a discontinuity in media timing.

methods.name: signalAudioSinkChanged
methods.description: Notifies that the audio sink has changed.

methods.name: notifyEOS
methods.description: Notifies end-of-stream for audio or video.

methods.name: notifyFlushComplete
methods.description: Notifies completion of a flush operation.

methods.name: notifyVideoLateBy
methods.description: Notifies how late video rendering is.

methods.name: dropBufferWhileFlushing
methods.description: Drops buffers during flushing if necessary.
